description: Complete automated dropshipping workflow using Shopify, Alibaba, and Amazon

tasks.name: Product Research
tasks.description: Use ChatGPT to analyze trending products and niches
steps: Query ChatGPT for trending products in specific niches
Analyze profit margins and competition
Identify winning products with high demand and low competition
Generate list of 10-20 potential products daily

tasks.name: Supplier Sourcing
steps: Search Alibaba/AliExpress for products from research
Filter suppliers by rating, MOQ, and price
Compare multiple suppliers for best pricing
Save supplier contacts and product details

tasks.name: Product Listing Creation
steps: Use ChatGPT to generate SEO-optimized product titles
Create product descriptions with persuasive copy
Generate bullet points highlighting key features
Use Canva API to create product images and banners
Import listings to Shopify via API

tasks.name: Pricing Optimization
tasks.description: Automatically set competitive prices with profit margins
steps: Monitor competitor prices on Amazon and other stores
Calculate optimal price with 30-50% markup
Apply dynamic pricing based on demand
Update Shopify prices via API

tasks.name: Marketing Content Creation
steps: Create Facebook/Instagram ad copy with ChatGPT
Design ad creatives using Canva templates
Generate email marketing campaigns
Create social media posts for product promotion

tasks.name: Order Fulfillment Automation
steps: Monitor Shopify for new orders via webhook
Extract order details and customer information
Automatically place order with supplier
Update customer with tracking information
Send confirmation emails

tasks.name: Customer Support Automation
steps: Monitor customer emails and messages
Use ChatGPT to generate responses
Handle common queries (shipping, returns, tracking)
Escalate complex issues to human review

tasks.name: Inventory Management
steps: Monitor supplier inventory levels
Update Shopify stock quantities
Disable out-of-stock products
Re-enable when back in stock

tasks.name: Analytics and Reporting
steps: Pull sales data from Shopify
Calculate profit margins and ROI
Identify best-performing products
Create visual reports in Notion dashboard
Send summary email with key metrics

tasks.name: Product Testing and Optimization
tasks.description: Test products and optimize based on performance
steps: Analyze product performance metrics
Identify underperforming products for removal
Scale successful products with increased ad spend
A/B test product descriptions and images
